parent_commands.implementation: scripts/verify_verus.py runs both verdicts through scripts/verify_local.py::contained under the shared lock, after checking all listed frontend hashes and the compiler identity.
parent_commands.run_order: Executed positive first with --no-cheating --num-threads 1 --time --output-json, then generated and verified the negative copy with the same options. Both verdicts passed their respective acceptance gates.

acceptance.positive: Require all three arbitrary-int theorems, quotient helpers, domain_witnesses, and ceil_mint_counterexample to verify with zero errors. Treat syntax, dependency, process, timeout, or unknown outcomes as undecided, not proof.
acceptance.negative: Require genuine assertion failures in exactly supply_delta and ceil_mint_counterexample for the ceil-mint mutation. At B=1,R=1500000000000,A=1 the claims delta is 2 > 1. A syntax/VIR error, unknown or nonzero exit alone is insufficient.
acceptance.witnesses: B=8,A=3 at R=Q/2,Q,3Q/2,Q+1, plus zero amounts and empty supply; these do not restrict the symbolic theorem domains.
acceptance.production_bridge: Open: no conclusion about production i128/I256 arithmetic, Rust dispatch, host calls, runtime, handlers, or end-to-end solvency.
